request.style: English, African-American spiritual, a strong female lead calling and a congregation answering in harmony, hand claps and foot stomps, a tambourine, no other instruments, fast and jubilant, 120 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Joshua marched around the town
And the walls came down
Seven priests with trumpets sound
And the walls came down
Six days round and nobody spoke
And the walls came down
On the seventh day the people shout
And the walls came down

[Chorus]
Shout, shout, the Lord has given you the city
Blow the trumpet, raise the cry
Shout, shout, the Lord has given you the city
Jericho is falling down

[Verse]
Seven times on the seventh day
And the walls came down
Trumpets blew and the people prayed
And the walls came down
A great shout went up to the sky
And the walls came down
Every stone fell where it lay
And the walls came down

[Chorus]
Shout, shout, the Lord has given you the city
Blow the trumpet, raise the cry
Shout, shout, the Lord has given you the city
Jericho is falling down
